conclusion: Behavioral tc_sram L2 banks dominate elaboration and AIG construction (52,460,372 nodes for one bank). With one-word banks the whole SoC elaborates in 4.249 s and synthesizes in 487.5 s; the merge optimization then dominates at about 480 s. The full SoC timeout is a memory-modeling limit, not a generate-scope limit.
